title: LEARN TO DANCE THE HUSTLE 🕺Basic Hustle Dance Steps for Beginners

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor pair provides clear verbal instruction alongside mirrored demonstrations. They break down footwork and hand placements separately for leaders and followers.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction of instructors and the dance style.
Explanation and demonstration of basic footwork and rock step timing.
Outside turn and inside turn mechanics.

metaphors: Bungee jumping with a bungee cord
common_mistakes: Putting all weight on the rock step

steps_taught.name: Rock Step
steps_taught.description: Stepping back with light weight on the heel

steps_taught.name: Basic Hustle
steps_taught.description: Rock step followed by two walking steps

what_works: Separating footwork explanation into leader and follower roles
Clear visual demonstrations of hand positioning
what_hinders: Rapid progression through multiple turn variations

quotes.text: If you ever wanted to learn the hustle, you're in the right place.
Easiest version, just the footwork first.
Imagine that, bungee jumping with a bungee cord.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor pair performing basic hustle steps facing forward
Male instructor demonstrating footwork counts while facing the camera
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: full body alignment from the side

extraction.distinctive_method: Using the 'newspaper' metaphor to describe arm positioning and opening space between partners.
